description: This file defines the SwiftUI view 'VoiceWakeOverlayView' which provides a user interface component for voice wake overlay interaction, including editing, displaying, and sending voice transcriptions, with various UI controls and state management.

classes.name: OverlayBackground
classes.description: A background view with a rounded rectangle shape, applying a visual effect and border stroke.

classes.name: CloseHoverButton
classes.description: A button for closing or dismissing the overlay, styled as a circular icon.

classes.name: CloseButtonOverlay
classes.description: A conditional overlay view that shows a close 'X' button when visible, with hover and click handling.

methods.name: updateFocusState
methods.description: Updates the focus state of the text input based on visibility and editing status.
